messages.text: Monday, September 28 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn air, a full moon rising, and local histories on display
A partly cloudy autumn day offers a high near 76°F. Local history is on display in Ypsilanti, while science explores the early assembly of our own galaxy.
Expect partly cloudy skies today with a high near 76°F and a low around 51°F.
Sunrise is at 7:28 AM, sunset at 7:20 PM, with a full moon 96.9% illuminated.
Local happenings and cultural notes

In Ypsilanti, the YDL-Superior is featuring the Ypsi Farmers & Gardeners Oral History Exhibit, offering a free look at local food growers. For music lovers, Spiral Galaxy performs at Trinosophes in Detroit at 7:30 PM.
Mark your calendar for September 30, which is My Birthday and Patrick's Birthday.
Ann Arbor's fiscal plans and U-M's cancer research

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for funds from a downtown property sale, allocating $14.2 million to $17.4 million across 12 projects. The University of Michigan has also established a $10 million center to advance soundwave cancer treatments.
Tomorrow's events and learning opportunities
Tomorrow offers a fireside chat on Black Reading Month at Howard Family Bookstore in Detroit at 6 PM, and an interactive workshop on AI for everyday use at Farmington Library at 6 PM.
Space telescope finds ancient galactic collision

NASA's Hubble telescope has identified evidence of an ancient collision with a dwarf galaxy that shaped the Milky Way's early assembly. Additionally, NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation in orbit.
The next Starship orbital flight attempt is estimated no earlier than September 18, 2026.
A quiet afternoon can hold a universe of discovery.
Tuesday, September 29 · Canton, Michigan
Overcast skies, a warm high, and a journey through AI

A day of overcast skies welcomes a high near 75°F, offering a comfortable late September feel. The local thread points to an exploration of artificial intelligence, while nearby events span film, comedy, and music.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 75°F and a low around 49°F; there is no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:29 AM, sunset at 7:19 PM, with the moon in a waning gibbous phase, 91.9% illuminated.
Explore Farmington's AI workshop or Detroit's film premiere

Consider the "AI for the Everyday: An Interactive Workshop" at Farmington Library starting at 6:00 PM. For those interested in film, the "Etched In Pavement - Documentary Film Premiere" is at the Charles H. Wright Museum of African American History in Detroit at 7:00 PM.
Tomorrow brings My Birthday and Patrick's Birthday.
State funding initiatives for first responders and workers

Michigan is allocating over $1 million for a first responder mental health initiative and $1.3 million for a health coverage program for low-income workers. Additional funds are directed towards workforce development and housing.
Ann Arbor's culinary and musical offerings for tomorrow
Tomorrow features "Foraging a Better Future" with Alexis N. Nelson at the U-M School of Environment and Sustainability and a musical performance by Kid Cooper Levy at North Star Lounge.
Satellites navigate without GPS, Hubble spots ancient merger

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and a catalog of space objects. Separately, the Hubble telescope identified a major merger from the Milky Way's infancy, pointing to an ancient collision with a dwarf galaxy.
The next Starship launch is estimated to be no earlier than September 18, 2026, with no official time provided.
The day unfolds with quiet possibilities.
